units: <cite ref="Eruvin 13b:13">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>המַשְׁפִּיל עצמו</he>; <he>הקב״ה מַשְׁפִּילוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="C00049"><he>גָּבַהּ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Nedarim 55a">Ned. 55ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 2:9">Is. II, 9</cite>) <he>אימתי שחו ונִשְׁפָּלוּ … הִשְׁפִּילָם הקב״ה</he> when did they sink and were lowered? When they committed that deed (worshipped the golden calf), the Lord lowered them.
<cite ref="Arakhin 15b:58">Arakh. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>יַשְׁפִּיל דעתו</he> let him humble his mind (think of his shortcomings).

<cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:25">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>ת̇ח̇כ̇מ̇נ̇י̇</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 23:8">II Sam. XXIII, 8</cite>) <he>הואיל והִשְׁפַּלְתָּ עצמך ת̇ה̇א כ̇מ̇ו̇נ̇י̇</he> because thou didst lower thyself, thou shalt be like myself; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be lowered. Pesik. R. l. c., v. supra.

same. Pesik. Ki Thissa, p. 11ᵇ (ref. to Is. II, 9) יודע … והָשְׁפַּלְתִּי אני והם וכ׳ I know that Israel bowed to the golden calf, and I and they have been lowered, but wilt thou not raise (forgive) them?; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 4 והשפלתי אותי and I myself have been lowered; Yalk. Is. 260 והוּשְׁפַּלְתִּי. Tanḥ. l. c. 5 (ref. to Ps. LXXV, 8) בלשון זה הו׳ וכ׳ for the word zeh (Ex. XXXII, 24) was he (Aaron) lowered, v. גָּבַהּ; בלשון זה הוּשְׁפָּלוּ וכ׳ through zeh (ib. 23) were they lowered, and with zeh (ib. XXX, 13) have they been raised; Lev. R. s. 8; a. fr.

units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> (ref. to <he>שפלות ידים</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 10:18">Koh. X, 18</cite>) <he>ע״י שנִשְׁתַּפְּלוּ ישראל מלחנות וכ׳</he> because the Israelites were too gentle to encamp (before Sinai) in discord &c.

senses.gloss: to be lazy, indolent. Ib. ע״י … מִשְׁתַּפֵּל מלקנח וכ׳ (not לקנח) because that man is too careless to wipe his body properly, he gets scabs. Ib. ע״י … מִשְׁתַּפֶּלֶת וכ׳ because that woman is too indolent to examine her body properly &c.; a. e.
